summary: Feed s084_single to IDS is degraded: 23.1% of frames (580/2506) arrive VXLAN-encapsulated. All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, drops, overload, truncation, VLAN, encryption, oversize) are healthy, but tunneled traffic blinds IDS inspection for nearly a quarter of traffic.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding VXLAN-encapsulated traffic without stripping the outer header (likely SPAN/mirror of VTEP or VXLAN overlay). IDS receives outer VXLAN/UDP/IP instead of inner Ethernet/IP payload.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot parse inner L2-L7 headers or apply signatures/content inspection to 23.1% of traffic; detection coverage reduced and tunneled attacks will be missed despite needs_full_payload=true.

recommended_fix.why: Strip/decapsulate VXLAN at the packet broker before delivery so IDS receives the inner frames for full signature matching. Requires broker VXLAN termination/decap feature.
